title: Unsupervised Post-Training of Foundation Models: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2608.24982v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation-model post-training usually relies on human labels, preference data, stronger teachers, or executable verifiers. We study Unsupervised Post-Training (UPT): update-bearing adaptation on unlabeled inputs whose learning signal is derived from same-lineage model artifacts rather than an external oracle. We catalog 80 strict UPT methods and organize them by the object that supplies the update signal: a prediction statistic, a sample relation, a self-generated target, or an internal evaluator. Beyond inventory, we show how the choice of internal signal and task structure determines whether post-training improves the model or recursively amplifies error. An orthogonal Input Visibility $\times$ Update Persistence view maps deployment regimes and defines a unified framework for UPT selection and evaluation.

translated_title: 基础模型的无监督后训练：一项综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24982v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基础模型的后训练通常依赖于人类标签、偏好数据、更强的教师模型或可执行的验证器。我们研究无监督后训练（UPT）：在未标记输入上进行的有更新适应，其学习信号源自同源模型产物而非外部预言机。我们整理了80种严格的UPT方法，并根据提供更新信号的对象对其进行分类：预测统计量、样本关系、自生成目标或内部评估器。除了清单之外，我们展示了内部信号和任务结构的选择如何决定后训练是改进模型还是递归放大错误。一个正交的输入可见性×更新持久性视角映射了部署场景，并定义了UPT选择和评估的统一框架。
tldr: 本文综述了80种无监督后训练方法，提出按内部信号源分类，并揭示了信号选择与任务结构决定模型改进或错误放大的关键机制。
en_tdlr: This survey catalogs 80 unsupervised post-training methods, classifies them by internal signal source, and reveals how signal choice and task structure determine model improvement versus error amplification.
